repository_identity.source: exact current-main commit SHA returned by the authorized GitHub connector/API

connector_native_checkpoint.source_rule: Fetch this one UTF-8 Python file from the exact rules_source_sha through the authorized GitHub connector/API and write only this file to a small temporary execution directory. Record the connector-returned Git blob SHA or equivalent canonical blob identity in connector evidence.

connector_evidence.purpose: Small deterministic evidence envelope assembled from exact-SHA connector reads so the standalone checkpoint can validate repository-backed facts without reconstructing repository files locally.
connector_evidence.drift_rule: Immediately before checkpoint/commit, re-query current main through the authorized connector. drift.status may be PASS only when current_main_sha equals rules_source_sha after any required refresh/revalidation.
connector_evidence.uniqueness_rule: Populate status=PASS only after connector inspection of the profile's current immutable identity namespace. New Ad-hoc is manual_on_demand only.
connector_evidence.selected_backgrounds_rule: Include only background IDs referenced by the authored pool. For each ID record current connector-backed hard-valid facts required by the checkpoint, including registered/selectable/active/verified/commercial-use/visual-review/rendition/watermark/text/category/duration/source-blob evidence. The full registry is never copied locally merely to run planner-time validation.

selected_background_policy.preferred_category_rule: Choose the semantically best suitable eligible category first.
selected_background_policy.fallback_rule: If the preferred category cannot form hard-valid primary and backup sequences, try another suitable eligible category, then use the canonical fallback category exposed by the exact-SHA checkpoint contract.

passes.name: contract_discovery_and_minimal_preflight
responsibilities: resolve current main and freeze rules_source_sha
inspect only background evidence needed for actual candidate selection

passes.name: creative_authorship_and_semantic_review
responsibilities: author exactly the production candidates actually required
repair or regenerate weak creative input automatically

passes.name: one_canonical_deterministic_checkpoint
responsibilities: rerun the same checkpoint until all required candidates pass

passes.name: drift_check_immutable_commit_end
responsibilities: refresh affected evidence/rules and revalidate on relevant drift
require PASS, commit_allowed=true, and exact draft_sha256 bytes
commit exactly one immutable pool artifact
end ChatGPT/Work planning after commit succeeds

automatic_recovery.story_failure: repair or regenerate affected candidate only
automatic_recovery.voice_failure: select an appropriate value from the current voice contract
automatic_recovery.preferred_background_failure: try alternate eligible category then canonical fallback
automatic_recovery.clip_failure: replace with a hard-valid clip from the same chosen category
automatic_recovery.sequence_failure: rebuild the affected sequence with valid clips/ranges
automatic_recovery.checkpoint_failure: read exact diagnostic, repair affected input, rerun same checkpoint
automatic_recovery.repository_drift: refresh affected rules/evidence, repair only if required, rerun checkpoint
automatic_recovery.retryable_commit_conflict: refresh main, apply drift policy, revalidate if required, retry safely

examples: authoritative current repository contract cannot be accessed
canonical connector checkpoint cannot be fetched/staged/executed
no hard-valid selected-background configuration exists after alternate eligible categories and canonical fallback are exhausted
authorized repository cannot accept immutable commit after safe conflict/drift retry
a current repository invariant makes the requested production state genuinely impossible

drift_policy.detection: re-query current main through authorized GitHub connector/API immediately before immutable commit
drift_policy.rules: refresh affected exact-SHA rules/checkpoint and rerun the canonical checkpoint
drift_policy.media: refresh selected-background evidence and rerun the canonical checkpoint
drift_policy.history: refresh duplicate/analytics/recent-background reasoning when relevant; rerun checkpoint whenever authored pool bytes change
drift_policy.operational: continue without restarting creative planning solely for unrelated operational evidence changes

forbidden_post_commit_actions: inspect production jobs as part of the same planner invocation
watch TTS or alignment or FFmpeg
wait for YouTube upload or verification

blocked_status.name: CHECKPOINT_STAGING_BLOCKED
legal_only_when: exact-SHA connector fetch of connector_checkpoint.py fails
connector-returned checkpoint blob identity is unavailable or inconsistent
the one checkpoint file cannot be written locally
the standalone checkpoint cannot execute with standard-library Python
not_legal_when: github.com shell Git DNS resolution fails
repository files have not been reconstructed locally
the full backgrounds registry has not been copied locally
global background inventory is below maintenance thresholds
legacy replenishment state exists or is incompatible

developer_ci_git_mode.rule: Developers/CI may continue using repository-native planner modules and the full test suite from a genuine checkout. This is separate from canonical ChatGPT/Work connector-native checkpoint execution.

forbidden_bootstrap_requirements: reconstructing the repository module tree before planning
copying the full background registry locally merely for planner validation
global media readiness before Daily or Ad-hoc planning
